description: This file implements a class `DbusMgr` that manages D-Bus connections and proxies for interacting with NetworkManager over D-Bus, including connection handling, proxy creation for various NetworkManager interfaces, and error handling. It is part of a GObject-based desktop or embedded application that interfaces with system network services.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic for establishing and managing D-Bus connections and proxies to interact with NetworkManager system services.
